Point $O$ is the center of a circle with diameter $AB$ (see figure). The angle $AOC$ is $100^\circ$, and $\alpha$ is the base angle at $C$ of the isosceles triangle $OBC$ (with $OB=OC$ being radii). The angle $\alpha$ has measure
A. $40^\circ$
B. $50^\circ$
C. $60^\circ$
D. $80^\circ$
tasks.notes: Angle BOC=180-100=80 (straight line AB); triangle OBC isosceles, 2alpha+80=180, alpha=50.
